name: Owlbear

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The owlbear makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage.

description: Part titanic owl, part ferocious bear, the owlbear is a territorial predator whose ear-splitting screech is often the last warning its prey ever gets.
